title: Astrid and the Extraction
author: Ines Ishikawa
blurb: Paloma Lockridge, a crash investigator whose family died in row twelve, has spent twelve years following rules that keep getting rewritten. Then a stranger returns a favor that never happened, with interest owed — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must trade the one secret worth killing for before the border checkpoint shifts change.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
